build_source: build a source object from the SourceModelBase model config
build_runtime_params: build runtime parameters for the source at a given time step
create_SourceModelBase: create a subclass of SourceModelBase with a model_name literal and implement abstract methods
review_SourceModelBase: review the SourceModelBase class that holds parameters common to all source models
test_model_func: test the model_func property that returns the source profile function
